settings.name: W4
settings.reason: A narrower band (0.8 of the normal width) for the seven-day rule: every half-hour variation sat exactly at 7 days on 2021 to 2023 with no room (measuring pass and first list). A narrower band is crossed more often, and its half-width stop is smaller, so fewer breakouts are skipped at $100. Otherwise W1. This band width was not measured. First list on 2021 to 2023, harsh fills: V5 (one trade a day, held to the close) had the best result per trade, +0.26 of the risk, with the shortest losing run (12); V2 +0.19, V7 +0.16, V6 +0.09, V4 +0.10, V3 +0.07, V8 -0.08.
